rationale: The last 5-minute candle printed roughly 6–8x the volume of the prior four candles while crashing from ~$11.43 to a low of $10.62 before partially recovering to $10.88 — a classic high-volume flush to the session low that could signal either capitulation (bullish reversal) or accelerating distribution (bearish continuation).
